overview_text: The combined major in health science and business administration provides students at Northeastern University with an opportunity to study a curriculum that is synergetic with the growing field of healthcare. This academic combination offers students the knowledge and expertise needed to enter a multitude of careers upon graduation. The degree allows students the unique opportunity to better understand the business side of the healthcare industry. The field is compatible with all the undergraduate concentrations in the School of Business and prepares students to enter the workforce after graduation.
